Yet on the whole there are two principles which may be detected as influencing the behaviour of the Turk in this matter, first and last, one being an affair of deliberate policy, the other instinctive and customary.

arxiv-1504-05082.title: Sur l’existence du schéma en groupes fondamental
arxiv-1504-05082.creator: Marco Antei, Michel Emsalem, Carlo Gasbarri
arxiv-1504-05082.description: Abstract Résumé. Soient S un schéma de Dedekind, X un S -schéma connexe localement de type fini et x\in X(S) une section. L’objet du présent papier est d’établir l’existence du schéma en groupes fondamental de X lorsque X est à fibres réduites ou quand X est normal.

arxiv-2207-10034.title: First look with JWST spectroscopy: z ∼ 8 z\sim 8 galaxies resemble local analogues
arxiv-2207-10034.creator: D. Schaerer, R. Marques-Chaves, L. Barrufet, P. Oesch, Y. I. Izotov 4, R. Naidu 5, N. G. Guseva 4, G. Brammer
arxiv-2207-10034.description: Abstract Deep images and near-IR spectra of galaxies in the field of the lensing cluster SMACS J0723.3-7327 were recently taken in the Early Release Observations program of JWST. Among these, two NIRSpec spectra of galaxies at z = 7.7 z=7.7 and one at z = 8.5 z=8.

arxiv-2311-17857.title: Gaussian Shell Maps for Efficient 3D Human Generation
arxiv-2311-17857.creator: Rameen Abdal, Wang Yifan, Zifan Shi, Yinghao Xu, Ryan Po, Zhengfei Kuang, Qifeng Chen, Dit-Yan Yeung, Gordon Wetzstein
arxiv-2311-17857.description: Abstract Efficient generation of 3D digital humans is important in several industries, including virtual reality, social media, and cinematic production. 3D generative adversarial networks (GANs) have demonstrated state-of-the-art (SOTA) quality and diversity for generated assets. Current 3D GAN architectures, however, typically rely on volume representations, which are slow to render, thereby hampering the GAN training and requiring multi-view-inconsistent 2D upsamplers.

arxiv-2312-00007.title: Space-Time Decomposition of Kalman Filter
arxiv-2312-00007.creator: Luisa D’Amore, Rosalba Cacciapuoti
arxiv-2312-00007.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Luisa D’Amore, Rosalba Cacciapuoti. We present an innovative interpretation of Kalman Filter (KF, for short) combining the ideas of Schwarz Domain Decomposition (DD) and Parallel in Time (PinT) approaches. Thereafter we call it DD-KF. In contrast to standard DD approaches which are already incorporated in KF and other state estimation models, implementing a straightforward data parallelism inside the loop over time, DD-KF ab-initio partitions the whole model, including filter equations and dynamic model along both space and time directions/steps.

arxiv-2401-12559.title: A robust balancing mechanism for spiking neural networks
arxiv-2401-12559.creator: Antonio Politi, Alessandro Torcini
arxiv-2401-12559.description: Abstract Dynamical balance of excitation and inhibition is usually invoked to explain the irregular low firing activity observed in the cortex. We propose a robust nonlinear balancing mechanism for a random network of spiking neurons, which works also in absence of strong external currents. Biologically, the mechanism exploits the plasticity of excitatory-excitatory synapses induced by short-term depression.

arxiv-2409-20028.title: A Quantum Unique Games Conjecture
arxiv-2409-20028.creator: Hamoon Mousavi, Taro Spirig
arxiv-2409-20028.description: Abstract After the NP-hardness of computational problems such as 3 3 SAT and MaxCut was established, a natural next step was to explore whether these problems remain hard to approximate. While the quantum extensions of some of these problems are known to be hard—indeed undecidable—their inapproximability remains largely unresolved.

arxiv-2501-09833.title: Erasing More Than Intended? How Concept Erasure Degrades the Generation of Non-Target Concepts
arxiv-2501-09833.creator: Ibtihel Amara, Ahmed Imtiaz Humayun, Ivana Kajic, Zarana Parekh, Natalie Harris, Sarah Young, Chirag Nagpal, Najoung Kim, Junfeng He, Cristina Nader Vasconcelos, Deepak Ramachandran, Golnoosh Farnadi, Katherine Heller, Mohammad Havaei, Negar Rostamzadeh
arxiv-2501-09833.description: Abstract Concept erasure techniques have recently gained significant attention for their potential to remove unwanted concepts from text-to-image models. While these methods often demonstrate promising results in controlled settings, their robustness in real-world applications and suitability for deployment remain uncertain.

arxiv-2505-07109.title: Buckling of residually stressed cylindrical tubes under compression
arxiv-2505-07109.creator: Tao Zhang, Luis Dorfmann, Yang Liu
arxiv-2505-07109.description: Abstract We evaluate the loss of stability of axially compressed slender and thick-walled tubes subject to a residual stress distribution. The nonlinear theory of elasticity, when used to analyze the underlying deformation, shows that the residual stress induces preferred directions in the reference configuration. The incremental theory, given in Stroh form, is used to derive an exact bifurcation condition.

pmc-11356473.title: Study on Effect of Surface Micro-Texture of Cemented Carbide on Tribological Properties of Bovine Cortical Bone
pmc-11356473.creator: Peng Shang, Bingfeng Liu, Chunhai Guo, Peijuan Cui, Zhanlin Hou, Fengbin Jin, Jianjun Zhang, Shijie Guo, Yuping Huang, Wenwu Zhang
pmc-11356473.description: In bone-milling surgical procedures, the intense friction between the tool and bone material often results in high cutting temperatures, leading to the thermal necrosis of bone cells. This paper aims to investigate the effect of micro-texture on the tribological properties of YG8 cemented carbide in contact with bone.

pmc-11612470.title: Infection of Helicobacter pylori contributes to the progression of gastric cancer through ferroptosis
pmc-11612470.creator: Yun Liu, Renjie Miao, Jinxuan Xia, Yong Zhou, Jun Yao, Shihe Shao
pmc-11612470.description: Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) is a gram-negative pathogen that colonizes gastric epithelial cells, and its chronic infection is the primary risk factor for the development of gastric cancer (GC). Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent form of cell death characterized by intracellular lipid peroxide accumulation and reactive oxygen species (ROS) imbalance.

pmc-12052224.title: Risk and pattern analysis of distant metastases in colon cancer: protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12052224.creator: Yonghua Hu, Qinglin Wei, Yang Yu, Haiyuan Li, Hao Chen
pmc-12052224.description: Background:Understanding the metastatic risks and patterns of colon cancer is crucial for patient evaluation and decision-making. However, high-quality evidence on colon cancer metastases is lacking. This study aims to conduct a systematic review and meta-analysis to determine the risk of site-specific metastasis and provide a complete profiling of distant metastasis in colon cancer.

pmc-12487248.title: Assessing physical activity literacy and practices among adults in the United Arab Emirates: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12487248.creator: Rifah Anwar Assadi, Afreen Abdul Rahim Sanaullah, Sathyapriya Nandagopal, Shahnaz Mohamed Wazil, Priya Pardasani, Meenadarsini Dhamothiran, And Ozyigit, Jagat Gopinath, Ans Ahmed Mahmood, Maryam Almarzooqi, Bibi Morsal Sayedy, Elham Riyaz, Jayakumary Muttappallymyalil
pmc-12487248.description: BackgroundPhysical inactivity among adults in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) is a growing public health concern, contributing to chronic diseases and increased healthcare burdens. Understanding physical activity literacy (PAL) and behaviour, along with associated sociodemographic factors, is essential for designing effective interventions.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted among 630 adults in UAE, using a validated self-administered questionnaire.

pmc-12644904.title: PER3 suppresses lung adenocarcinomatous cell proliferation/migration through activating AMPK/mTOR pathway
pmc-12644904.creator: Guanli Yuan, Yinfeng Liu, Dawei Wu, Jingping Xu
pmc-12644904.description: Dysregulation of circadian rhythm genes is related to the increased risk of development of various human cancers. This study investigated the biological roles of Period circadian regulator 3 (PER3) in the development and progression of lung adenocarcinoma and related underlying mechanisms. The expression of PER3 was decreased in lung adenocarcinoma and its low expression was correlated with advanced disease stages.

pmc-12697346.title: Efficient Estimation of Nucleotide Diversity and Divergence Using Callable Loci (and More)
pmc-12697346.creator: Cade Mirchandani, Erik Enbody, Timothy B Sackton, Russ Corbett-Detig, Kelley Harris
pmc-12697346.description: The increasing scale of population genomic datasets presents computational challenges in estimating summary statistics such as nucleotide diversity (π) and divergence (dxy). Accurate estimates of diversity require knowledge of missing data, and existing tools require all-site VCFs. However, generating these files is computationally expensive for large datasets.

pmc-12708763.title: Research on the impact of ecological additives on selected parameters and the microbiological distribution of marine engine oil
pmc-12708763.creator: Rafał Krakowski
pmc-12708763.description: The article presents the impact of ecological additives on selected parameters and the microbiological distribution of marine engine oil (Marinol). With the development of industry and the automotive sector in general, it has become apparent that the problem of microbial contamination is still relevant and is becoming increasingly widespread.

pmc-12722701.title: Correlation stabilized anomalous Hall crystal in bilayer graphene
pmc-12722701.creator: Zhongqing Guo, Jianpeng Liu
pmc-12722701.description: At low carrier densities, interacting electrons can form a Wigner crystal. Rhombohedral multilayer graphene hosts high-order Dirac fermions with nontrivial Berry phases. Using a beyond-mean-field theoretical framework, here we study the ground states of slightly charge-doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene under vertical displacement field.

pmc-13030108.title: Effect of Pre-Exposure to Deoxynivalenol on the Response of Porcine Intestinal Epithelial Cells to F18 E. coli Infection
pmc-13030108.creator: Madison Brackett, Paul Oladele, Hang Lu, Nathan Horn, Kolapo M. Ajuwon
pmc-13030108.description: The mycotoxin deoxynivalenol (DON) is a common contaminant found in swine diets, causing decreased growth performance and poor health. Additionally, F18 enterotoxigenic E. coli is a leading cause of post-weaning diarrhea. Nursery pigs are often exposed to each of them after weaning; however, it is unknown what impact the combination of these stressors has on gastrointestinal health.

pmc-13126100.title: Strategic Delay and Bargaining Over Public Insurance Coverage for Drugs in Australia
pmc-13126100.creator: Jing Jing Li, Anthony Harris
pmc-13126100.description: Public funding for pharmaceuticals often follows repeated negotiation between manufacturers and a public agency, yet little empirical work examines how the timing of agreement reflects the economic structure of these interactions. Using a duration model of negotiations in Australia from 2005 to 2018, we assess whether observed patterns of delay and agreement align with dynamic bargaining theory under incomplete information.

pmc-13187031.title: Alcohol consumption and its association with biochemical indicators and quality of life among rural adults in Northern Thailand
pmc-13187031.creator: Surangkana Chairinkam, Wannita Sakulwattana, Katekaew Seangpraw, Parichat Ong-Artborirak, Nestor Asiamah, Sasivimol Bootsikeaw, Prapaporn Tulwattanakul, Nutthaphong Mated, Manuchet Manotham
pmc-13187031.description: The prevalence of Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD) is rising in Thailand, but there is still a lack of adequate diagnosis, reporting, and management. This study aimed to assess alcohol consumption and its association with demographic variables, biochemical markers, and quality of life (QoL) among adults living in rural Northern Thailand.

pmc-13491343.title: Safety and Feasibility of Same-Day Discharge After Balloon Pulmonary Angioplasty for Chronic Thromboembolic Pulmonary Hypertension: A Single-Center Retrospective Study
pmc-13491343.creator: Kevin Jin, Kelley Chen, Benjamin L Magod, Zhiying Meng, Heather Byrd, Abigail S Baldridge, Daniel J Romary, Benjamin H Freed, Yasmin Raza, Maanasi Samant, Ruben Mylvaganam, Michael J Cuttica, S Chris Malaisrie, Stephen F Chiu, Daniel R Schimmel
pmc-13491343.description: BackgroundBalloon pulmonary angioplasty (BPA) is increasingly used for patients with inoperable or residual chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension. Overnight observation is the current standard practice. We evaluated the safety and feasibility of same-day discharge (SDD) after BPA at a contemporary US referral center.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed consecutive chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension patients undergoing BPA between 2018 and 2024.

uslaw-usc-t48-s733a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t48-s733a.description: United States Code, Title 48 (Territories And Insular Possessions); Chapter 4 (Puerto Rico); Subchapter I (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. All citizens of the United States who have resided or who shall after March 4, 1927, reside in the island for one year shall be citizens of Puerto Rico.
